option.description: Power-flow execution option mnemonic. Examples include QLIM, CREM, STEP, NEWT, MOST, MOSG, MOSF, RCVG, RMON, FILE, CONT, CELO and MFCT.

state.description: Option activation state. L indicates that the execution option is enabled.

options.CELO: Activates simultaneous Newton-Raphson solution of AC-DC link equations.
options.CONT: Prints terminal reports continuously without pagination pauses.
options.MOCF: Monitors MVA power flow on all system circuits.
options.MOCG: Monitors reactive generation on all AC generator buses.
options.MOCT: Monitors voltage on all AC buses.
options.MOSF: Monitors only selected AC circuit flows.
options.MOSG: Monitors only selected AC generator reactive outputs.
options.MOST: Monitors only selected AC bus voltages.
options.NEWT: Solves the nonlinear power-flow equations with Newton-Raphson instead of fast decoupled power flow.
options.RCVG: Prints iterative convergence reports for AC, DC and AC-DC interface solutions.
options.STEP: Limits voltage angle, voltage magnitude and CSC susceptance corrections during iterations.

DOPC.function: Reading of power-flow execution options. Records are represented by repeated option/state pairs.

mnemonic.description: Constant mnemonic to be modified before execution of codes that use it.

value.description: New value associated with the DCTE constant mnemonic.

constants.ACIT: Maximum number of iterations in the AC power-flow solution.
constants.APAS: Continuation power-flow loading point from which parametrized step size is accelerated, in percent of maximum loading.
constants.ASDC: Maximum firing/extinction angle correction of the DC link converter during solution.
constants.ASTP: Maximum voltage phase-angle correction during the solution process, in radians.
constants.BASE: AC system power base, in MVA.
constants.BFPO: Minimum reactive power injection of a shunt bank allocated by Flupot, in MVAr.
constants.CPAR: Stopping point of the parametrized continuation power flow, in percent of maximum loading.
constants.CSTP: Maximum CSC susceptance correction during the solution process, in percent.
constants.DASE: Default DC system power base, in MW.
constants.DCIT: Maximum number of iterations in the DC power-flow solution.
constants.DMAX: Maximum consecutive applications of the FDIV division factor in continuation power flow.
constants.FDIV: Automatic load increment reduction factor when continuation power flow has no solution.
constants.HIST: Number of case records stored in ANAREDE format.
constants.ICIT: Maximum number of power-flow solutions during continuation power flow.
constants.ICMN: Minimum automatic load increment and parametrization threshold when PARM is active.
constants.ICMV: Initial step size when the continuation parameter changes from loading to voltage magnitude.
constants.LCRT: Maximum report lines per page on logical unit 6.
constants.LFCV: Fast-decoupled iterations before switching to Newton-Raphson.
constants.LFIT: Maximum iterations in the AC-DC interface solution.
constants.LPIT: Maximum iterations of the linear programming problem.
constants.LPRT: Maximum report lines per page on logical unit 4.
constants.NDIR: Number of directions used while building the security region.
constants.PDIT: Number of iterations used in loss estimation for the linearized load-flow model.
constants.PGER: Percentage of internal-system active generation removed to calculate active-power flow variations in external-system circuits.
constants.QLST: Reactive-power error tolerance for reactive generation limit control.
constants.STIR: Division factor for the current active-generation transfer step when a violation occurs while building the security region.
constants.STTR: Active-generation transfer step used while building the security region.
constants.TADC: Tolerance for converter firing/extinction angle limits.
constants.TBPA: Tolerance for active-power redistribution error in generation/load contingencies.
constants.TEPA: Active-power mismatch convergence tolerance at the bus, in MW.
constants.TEPR: Reactive-power mismatch convergence tolerance at the bus, in MVAr.
constants.TETP: Active-power interchange error tolerance between areas, in MW.
constants.TLMG: Load-flow generation limit monitoring factor constant.
constants.TLMT: Load-flow voltage limit monitoring factor constant.
constants.TLPP: Circuit loading capacity tolerance, in percent.
constants.TLPR: Reactive generation limit tolerance, in MVAr.
constants.TLTC: Transformer tap limit tolerance, in percent.
constants.TRPT: Percentage of active generation transferred while building the security region.
constants.TSBA: Tolerance for small active-power flow variations in external system circuits, in MW.
constants.TSBZ: Tolerance for null active-power flow variation detection in external system circuits, in MW.
constants.TSDC: Maximum DC link converter tap correction during the solution process.
constants.TSFR: Tolerance for physical electrical-network separation detection.
constants.TSTP: Number of discrete tap transformer steps.
constants.TUDC: DC bus voltage mismatch convergence tolerance, in percent.
constants.TLSI: Tolerance for the inverted sensitivity report used to determine buses with inverted dQ/dV sensitivity.
constants.VART: Voltage variation threshold for automatic monitoring in continuation power flow.
constants.VAVF: Flow variation criterion based on nominal loading for complementary network determination.
constants.VAVT: Voltage variation criterion for complementary network determination.
constants.VDVM: Maximum voltage for automatic case divergence test, in percent.
constants.VDVN: Minimum voltage for automatic case divergence test, in percent.
constants.VFLD: Voltage below which constant-power functional loads are modeled as constant impedance, in percent.
constants.VINF: Variation used to define lower report-band limits for RFXC and RFXS.
constants.VMVF: Flow variation criterion for complementary network determination, in MW.
constants.VPMF: Flow variation criterion for the simulation network first criterion, in MW.
constants.VPVF: Flow variation criterion based on nominal loading for the simulation network first criterion.
constants.VPVT: Voltage variation criterion for the simulation network first criterion.
constants.VSIT: Maximum iterations for DC bus voltage adjustment.
constants.VSTP: Maximum voltage magnitude correction during the solution process, in percent.
constants.VSUP: Variation used to define upper report-band limits for RFXC and RFXS.
constants.VSVF: Flow variation criterion based on nominal loading for the simulation network second criterion.
constants.ZMAX: Impedance limit above which equivalent circuits are neglected, in percent.
constants.ZMIN: Minimum AC circuit impedance magnitude, in percent.

DCTE.function: Reading and modification of program constants. Records are represented by repeated mnemonic/value pairs.

active_generation.description: Active power generation value at the bus, in MW. This field defines the base operating point over which control actions are executed to maintain the programmed active power exchange between areas. Active power exchange errors between areas are distributed among area generators, based on this value and according to each generator's participation.

active_load.description: Bus active load value, in MW. In case the load varies with bus voltage magnitude, enter in this field the load value for the voltage specified in the Voltage For Load Definition field.

angle.description: Initial phase angle of bus voltage, in degrees.

area.description: Number of the area to which the bus belongs.

capacitor_reactor.description: Total reactive power injected at the bus, in MVAr, by capacitor/reactor banks. The value to be filled in this field refers to the reactive power injected at nominal voltage (1.0 p.u.). This value must be positive for capacitors and negative for reactors.

controlled_bus.description: For voltage regulated and reference buses, with specified reactive power limits, this field is for the number of the bus whose voltage magnitude will be controlled. The voltage magnitude value to be maintained is obtained from the Voltage field of the record relative to the bus.

max_reactive_generation.description: Maximum reactive power generation limit value at the bus, in MVAr.

min_reactive_generation.description: Minimum reactive power generation limit value at the bus, in MVAr.

operation.description:
A or 0 - Bus data addition.
E or 1 - Elimination of bus data.
M or 2 - Modification of bus data.

reactive_generation.description: Reactive power generation value at the bus, in MVAr. For load bus this value is fixed. For load bus with voltage limit this value is kept constant, while voltage magnitude remains between specified limits. For voltage regulated and reference buses with specified reactive power generation limits, this field can be left blank.

reactive_load.description: Bus reactive load value, in MVAr. In case the load varies with bus voltage magnitude, enter in this field the load value for the voltage specified in the Voltage For Load Definition field.

state.description:
L - Bus in service (connected/ligado) 
D - Bus out of service (disconnected/desligado)

type.description:
0 - Load bus (PQ - Fixed active and reactive power injections).
1 - Voltage regulated bus (PV - Fixed active power injection and voltage magnitude).
2 - Reference bus (V - Fixed voltage magnitude and phase angle).
3 - Load bus with voltage limits (PQ - Fixed active and reactive power injections while voltage magnitude remains within limit values).

visualization_mode.description:
Enter in this field the AC bus visualization mode in the single-line diagram:
0 - normal bus.
1 - midpoint bus.
2 - auxiliary bus.

voltage.description: Initial value of voltage magnitude, in p.u. For voltage controlled bus, remotely or not, by reactive power generation or transformer tap variation, this field must be filled with the voltage magnitude value to be kept constant. Implicit decimal point between columns 25 and 26.

voltage_base_group.description: Voltage Base Group identifier to which the AC bus belongs, composed of up to two characters of digit type (0 to 9) or character (A to Z), as defined in the DGBT Execution Code. The values associated with Voltage Base Groups are defined in the DGBT execution code. Groups that are not defined will have a value equal to 1 kV.

voltage_for_load_definition.description: Enter in this field the p.u. voltage value for which the active and reactive load portions defined in the Active Load and Reactive Load fields, respectively, were measured. Implicit decimal point between columns 77 and 78.

voltage_limit_group.description: Voltage Limit Group identifier to which the AC bus belongs, composed of up to two characters of digit type (0 to 9) or character (A to Z), as defined in the DGLT Execution Code. The values associated with Voltage Limit Groups are defined in the DGLT Execution Code. Groups that are not defined will have minimum and maximum voltage limit values equal to 0.8 and 1.2 pu, respectively.

clear_dbar_data.description: S if the value informed in the DBAR Capacitor/Reactor field must be cleared. Otherwise the DBAR value is preserved.

controlled_bus.description: Bus number whose voltage magnitude is controlled by automatic switching of the individualized capacitor and/or reactor banks connected to the terminal bus. The controlled voltage depends on the voltage range and the selected control type.

control_mode.description: Automatic bank switching control mode: C for continuous control, D for discrete control, or F for fixed control.

control_type.description: Voltage control type: C if control is performed by the center of the voltage range, or L if control is performed by the violated limit of the voltage range.

dbsh_circuit.description: Identification number of the parallel AC circuit when the individualized capacitor/reactor bank is connected to a transmission line.

extremity_bus.description: Bus number corresponding to the circuit extremity where the shunt capacitor/reactor bank is installed.

from_bus.description: Bus identification number to which the shunt capacitor/reactor bank is connected, or one terminal of the circuit to which the line bank is connected.

initial_reactive_injection.description: Initial total reactive power injection at the terminal bus, in MVAr, due to the set of capacitor and/or reactor banks connected to the bus. When Control Mode is F, this value represents the effective fixed injection at the bus.

maximum_voltage.description: Maximum voltage limit of the control range that determines automatic bank switching action. If this field is blank, the maximum voltage is taken from the voltage limit group to which the bus belongs. Implicit decimal point between columns 25 and 26.

minimum_voltage.description: Minimum voltage limit of the control range that determines automatic bank switching action. If this field is blank, the minimum voltage is taken from the voltage limit group to which the bus belongs. Implicit decimal point between columns 20 and 21.

operation.description: A or 0 - terminal bus data addition. E or 1 - terminal bus data elimination. M or 2 - terminal bus data modification.

to_bus.description: Bus number of the other circuit terminal for line capacitor/reactor banks. Not used for shunt banks connected directly to an AC bus.

bank_number.description: Identification number of the capacitor and/or reactor group or bank. One bus may have one or more groups or banks, and each group may consist of one or more equal switching stages.

operation.description: A or 0 - group or bank data addition. E or 1 - group or bank data elimination. M or 2 - group or bank data modification.

reactive_power_per_unit.description: Total reactive power injected at the bus by one unit or stage of the capacitor/reactor group, in MVAr at nominal voltage (1.0 p.u.). Positive values represent capacitors and negative values represent reactors.

state.description: L if the group or bank is in operation. D if the group or bank is out of operation.

total_units.description: Total number of equal units or stages that compose the capacitor/reactor group or bank. The maximum number of units allowed per bus is six.

units_in_operation.description: Number of equal units or stages of the capacitor/reactor group or bank that are effectively in operation.

DBSH.function: Reading of individualized capacitor and/or reactor bank data connected to AC buses or transmission lines. For each terminal bus record, one or more bank records follow, and an FBAN record in columns 1-4 terminates the bank list for that terminal bus.

area_number.description: Area number, as defined in the Area field of the DBAR execution code.

maximum_net_interchange.description: Maximum net active power interchange of the area, in MW. Positive values indicate export and negative values indicate import.

minimum_net_interchange.description: Minimum net active power interchange of the area, in MW. Positive values indicate export and negative values indicate import.

net_interchange.description: Net active power interchange of the area, in MW. Positive values indicate export and negative values indicate import.

DARE.function: Reading of active power interchange data between areas.

active_power.description: Active power value of the individualized load group, in MW. If the load varies with bus voltage magnitude, enter the load value for the voltage specified in the Voltage for Load Definition field.

bus.description: Bus identification number, as defined in the Bus field of the DBAR Execution Code, to which this group of individualized loads is connected.

group.description: Identification number of the individualized load group. Multiple groups can be connected to one bus and a group can consist of one or more individualized loads.

operation.description:
A or 0 - addition of individualized load group data.
E or 1 - elimination of individualized load group data.
M or 2 - modification of individualized load group data.

parameter_a.description: Portion of individualized active load that varies linearly with voltage magnitude, in %.

parameter_b.description: Portion of individualized active load that varies with the square of voltage magnitude, in %.

parameter_c.description: Portion of individualized reactive load that varies linearly with voltage magnitude, in %.

parameter_d.description: Portion of individualized reactive load that varies with the square of voltage magnitude, in %.

reactive_power.description: Reactive power value of the individualized load group, in MVAr. If the load varies with bus voltage magnitude, enter the load value for the voltage specified in the Voltage for Load Definition field.

state.description:
L if the load group is in operation (connected).
D if the load group is out of operation (disconnected).

total_units.description: Total number of equal units that compose the individualized load group. This serves as memory of the total number of units or stages in the group.

units_in_operation.description: Number of equal units or stages that compose the individualized load group that are effectively in operation.

voltage_for_load_definition.description: Voltage value in p.u. for which the active and reactive load portions defined in Active Power and Reactive Power fields were measured. Implicit decimal point between columns 57 and 58.

voltage_limit.description: Voltage value below which the constant power portion of functional individualized loads is modeled as constant impedance, in %.

DCAI.function: Reading of individualized load parameters. This code allows defining groups of individualized loads connected to buses, where each group can consist of multiple identical units with voltage-dependent characteristics.

bus.description: Bus Number as defined in the Number field of the DBAR Execution Code.

control_mode.description:
P – Control by power generated by the SVC.
I – Control by current injected by the SVC.

controlled_bus.description: Bus Number as defined in the Number field of the DBAR Execution Code whose voltage will be controlled by the value defined in the Voltage field of the DBAR Execution Code.

group.description: Identification number of the static reactive compensator group. One or more SVC groups can be connected to a bus and a group can be composed of one or more static compensators.

max_reactive_generation.description: Maximum reactive power generation limit value, in Mvar, that defines the limits of the linear part of the Static Reactive Compensator model control curve.

min_reactive_generation.description: Minimum reactive power generation limit value, in Mvar, that defines the limits of the linear part of the Static Reactive Compensator model control curve.

operation.description:
A or 0 - static reactive compensator data addition.
E or 1 - static reactive compensator data elimination.
M or 2 - static reactive compensator data modification.

slope.description: Slope value of the line that defines the linear part of the Static Reactive Compensator model control curve, in %.

state.description:
L if the compensator group is in operation (connected).
D if the compensator group is out of operation (disconnected).

units.description: Number of equal units that compose the SVC group.

DCER.function: Reading of static reactive compensator data.

bypass.description:
L if the bypass switch is closed (connected).
D if the bypass switch is open (disconnected).

control_mode.description:
P - Constant power. The specified value for active power flow in the circuit is maintained while CSC reactance values remain within limits.
I - Constant current. The specified value for current magnitude in the circuit is maintained while CSC reactance values remain within limits.
X - Constant reactance. The CSC does not act and reactance is fixed at the specified value.

dcsc_circuit.description: Identification number of the parallel AC circuit.

from_bus.description: Number of the bus at one end of the CSC as defined in the Number field of the DBAR Execution Code.

initial_reactance.description: Initial value of CSC reactance, in %.

max_reactance.description: Maximum value of CSC reactance, in %.

measurement_terminal.description: Number of the CSC terminal bus at which power or current is measured, as defined in the Number field of the DBAR Execution Code.

min_reactance.description: Minimum value of CSC reactance, in %.

number_of_stages.description: Number of stages of the discrete CSC (TSSC - Thyristor Switched Series Capacitor). The default value is for CSC operating in continuous mode (TCSC - Thyristor Controlled Series Capacitor).

operation.description:
A or 0 - CSC data addition.
E or 1 - CSC data elimination.
M or 2 - CSC data modification.

owner.description:
F if the circuit belongs to the area of the bus defined in the From Bus field.
T if the circuit belongs to the area of the bus defined in the To Bus field.

specified_value.description: Active Power Flow in the CSC, in MW, if the specified control mode is Constant Power (P), or; CSC Current Magnitude, in pu, if the specified control mode is Constant Current (I), or; CSC Reactance, in %, if the specified control mode is Constant Reactance (X).

state.description:
L if the circuit is in operation (connected).
D if the circuit is out of operation (disconnected).

to_bus.description: Number of the bus at the other end of the CSC as defined in the Number field of the DBAR Execution Code.

DCSC.function: Reading of CSC (Controllable Series Compensator) data.

curve_id.description: Identifier of the point-curve data associated with the complementary transformer record, when provided.

dctr_circuit.description: Identification number of the parallel AC circuit.

from_bus.description: Number of one terminal bus of the circuit, as defined in the Number field of the DBAR Execution Code.

maximum_phase_shift.description: Maximum phase-angle value, in degrees. Implicit decimal point between columns 43 and 44.

maximum_voltage.description: Maximum voltage magnitude of the controlled bus, in p.u. Implicit decimal point between columns 23 and 24.

measurement_terminal.description: Bus where the control variable is measured.

minimum_phase_shift.description: Minimum phase-angle value, in degrees. Implicit decimal point between columns 36 and 37.

minimum_voltage.description: Minimum voltage magnitude of the controlled bus, in p.u. Implicit decimal point between columns 18 and 19.

number_of_taps.description: Number of phase-shifting transformer tap positions, including minimum and maximum taps. Not implemented in this ANAREDE version according to the manual.

operation.description: A or 0 - addition of complementary transformer data. E or 1 - elimination of complementary transformer data. M or 2 - modification of complementary transformer data.

phase_control_type.description: F - Fixed. C - Current control. P - Active-power control.

phase_mode.description: C - Continuous phase control. D - Discrete phase control.

specified_value.description: Specified current when Phase Control Type is C, in p.u.; or specified active power when Phase Control Type is P, in MW.

to_bus.description: Number of the other terminal bus of the circuit, as defined in the Number field of the DBAR Execution Code.

voltage_control_type.description: C - Center of voltage band. L - Voltage band limits.

DCTR.function: Reading of complementary transformer data for LTC transformers with voltage-band control and phase-shifting transformers with automatic phase variation.

max_active_generation.description: Maximum active power generation limit value at the bus, in MW.

min_active_generation.description: Minimum active power generation limit value at the bus, in MW.

nominal_apparent_power.description: Machine nominal apparent power, in MVA

number.description: Bus number, as defined in the Number field of the DBAR Execution Code.

operation.description:
A or 0 - addition of active power generation limits and participation factors data
M or 2 - modification of active power generation limits and participation factors data

participation_factor.description: Generation bus participation factor value, in %. The active power interchange error of each area is distributed among the area generation buses, proportionally to each one's participation factor, observing the respective minimum and maximum active power generation limits.

remote_control_participation_factor.description: Generator participation factor in the amount of reactive power needed for remote bus voltage control in %.

DGER.function: Reading of active power generation limits and participation factors.

controlled_bus.description: In the case of transformer type circuits with automatic tap variation, this field is for the number of the bus whose voltage magnitude should be controlled.

dlin_circuit.description: Identification number of the parallel AC circuit.

emergency_capacity.description: Circuit loading capacity under emergency conditions for flow monitoring purposes, in MVA.

equipment_capacity.description: Loading capacity of the equipment with the smallest loading capacity connected to the circuit.

from_bus.description: Number of the bus at one end of the circuit as defined in the Number field of the DBAR Execution Code.

normal_capacity.description: Circuit loading capacity under normal conditions for flow monitoring purposes, in MVA.

number_of_taps.description: Number of positions of the variable tap transformer, including the minimum tap and maximum tap.

operation.description:
A or 0 - Circuit data addition.
E or 1 - Circuit data elimination.
M or 2 - Circuit data modification.

owner.description:
F if the circuit belongs to the area of the bus defined in the From Bus field.
T if the circuit belongs to the area of the bus defined in the To Bus field.

phase_shift.description: Phase shift angle value, in degrees, for phase shifting transformers. The specified angular phase shift is applied relative to the angle of the bus defined in the From Bus field. Implicit decimal point between columns 56 and 57.

reactance.description: Circuit reactance value, in %. For transformers this value corresponds to the reactance value for the nominal tap. Implicit decimal point between columns 30 and 31.

resistance.description: Circuit resistance value, in %. For transformers this value corresponds to the resistance value for the nominal tap. Implicit decimal point between columns 24 and 25.

state.description:
L if the circuit is in operation (connected).
D if the circuit is out of operation (disconnected).

susceptance.description: Total shunt susceptance value of the circuit, in Mvar. Implicit decimal point between columns 35 and 36.

tap.description: Tap value referred to the bus defined in the From Bus field, in p.u., for fixed tap transformers or an estimate of this value for automatic tap changing transformers (LTC). Implicit decimal point between columns 40 and 41.

tap_maximum.description: Maximum value that the tap can assume, in p.u., for automatic tap changing transformers. Implicit decimal point between columns 50 and 51.

tap_minimum.description: Minimum value that the tap can assume, in p.u., for automatic tap changing transformers. Implicit decimal point between columns 45 and 46.

to_bus.description: Number of the bus at the other end of the circuit as defined in the Number field of the DBAR Execution Code.

dshl_circuit.description: Identification number of the parallel AC circuit.

from_bus.description: Number of the bus at one end of the AC circuit as defined in the Number field of the DBAR Execution Code.

operation.description:
A or 0 - addition of AC circuit shunt device data.
E or 1 - elimination of AC circuit shunt device data.
M or 2 - modification of AC circuit shunt device data.

shunt_from.description: Reactive power of shunts at the end defined in the From Bus field for nominal voltage (1.0 p.u.), in MVAr.

shunt_to.description: Reactive power of shunts at the end defined in the To Bus field for nominal voltage (1.0 p.u.), in MVAr.

state_from.description:
L if the line shunt at this end is in operation (connected).
D if the line shunt at this end is out of operation (disconnected).

state_to.description:
L if the line shunt at this end is in operation (connected).
D if the line shunt at this end is out of operation (disconnected).

to_bus.description: Number of the bus at the other end of the circuit as defined in the Number field of the DBAR Execution Code.

DSHL.function: Reading of AC circuit shunt device data. This code allows associating shunt devices to AC network circuits to facilitate fault simulation. These devices are automatically removed or inserted together with the associated circuit.

converter_angle.description: Desired firing angle for a rectifier, extinction angle for a conventional inverter, or commutation margin for a CCC inverter, in degrees.

converter_control_type.description: Converter control type: C for constant-current control, or P for constant-power control.

current_margin.description: Inverter current margin, in percent of the nominal current defined in the DCNV Current field. This field is not considered for rectifiers.

dc_voltage_minimum_for_power_control.description: Minimum DC voltage, in p.u., below which a converter in power control changes to current control. Implicit decimal point between columns 63 and 64.

inverter_control_mode.description: Inverter control mode for CCC inverters: G for gamma control, or T for AC interface bus voltage control.

maximum_converter_angle.description: Maximum firing angle for a rectifier, extinction angle for a conventional inverter, or commutation margin for a CCC inverter, in degrees.

maximum_overcurrent.description: Maximum overcurrent allowed for the converter, in percent of the nominal current defined in the DCNV Current field. This field is not considered for rectifiers.

maximum_transformer_tap.description: Maximum tap value of the converter transformer.

minimum_converter_angle.description: Minimum firing angle for a rectifier, extinction angle for a conventional inverter, or commutation margin for a CCC inverter, in degrees.

minimum_transformer_tap.description: Minimum tap value of the converter transformer.

number.description: Converter identification number, as defined in the Number field of the DCNV execution code.

operation.description: A or 0 - converter control data addition. E or 1 - converter control data elimination. M or 2 - converter control data modification.

slack.description: F for a slack converter, or N for a normal converter. One slack converter must be specified for each pole of the DC link.

specified_value.description: Specified converter control value, in A for current control or MW for power control.

tap_himvar_mode.description: Converter transformer tap used when the DC link operates in HiMVAr Consumption mode, as defined in the DELO HiMVAr Mode field.

tap_reduced_voltage_mode.default: Maximum transformer tap minus one step, or 1.0 when the tap step is not available
tap_reduced_voltage_mode.description: Converter transformer tap used when the DC link operates in reduced-voltage mode.

transformer_tap_steps.description: Number of converter transformer tap steps. The tap step is calculated by dividing the difference between maximum and minimum transformer taps by this number of steps.

DCCV.function: Reading of AC-DC converter control data.

dc_link_number.description: DC link number, as defined in the Number field of the DELO execution code. All buses of the same pole or bipole must belong to the same DC link.

ground_electrode_resistance.description: Ground electrode resistance, in ohms, for a neutral bus. This field must not be filled for positive- or negative-polarity buses.

name.description: Alphanumeric identification of the DC bus.

operation.description: A or 0 - DC bus data addition. M or 2 - DC bus data modification.

polarity.description: + indicates that the bus belongs to the positive pole. - indicates that the bus belongs to the negative pole. 0 indicates a neutral bus.

type.description: 0 - bus without specified voltage. 1 - bus with specified voltage, used as a reference bus. One type-1 bus must be specified for each pole of each DC link.

voltage.description: Initial voltage magnitude of the DC bus, in kV. For type-1 buses this field contains the voltage value to be held constant.

voltage_limit_group.description: Voltage limit group identifier associated with the DC bus.

capacity.description: DC line loading capacity, in MW, for flow monitoring purposes.

dcli_circuit.description: Identification number of the parallel DC line.

from_bus.description: Number of the DC bus at one end of the DC line, as defined in the Number field of the DCBA execution code.

operation.description: A or 0 - DC line data addition. M or 2 - DC line data modification.

owner.description: Owner flag. This field is not used in this version.

to_bus.description: Number of the DC bus at the other end of the DC line, as defined in the Number field of the DCBA execution code.

ac_bus.description: AC bus number to which the converter is connected, as defined in the Number field of the DBAR execution code.

commutation_reactance.description: Commutation reactance per six-pulse bridge, in percent on the converter transformer power base.

dc_bus.description: DC bus number to which the converter is connected, as defined in the Number field of the DCBA execution code.

frequency.description: Frequency, in Hz, of the AC system to which the CCC is connected.

mode.description: Converter operating mode: R for rectifier, or I for inverter.

neutral_bus.description: Neutral DC bus number to which the converter is connected, as defined in the Number field of the DCBA execution code.

operation.description: A or 0 - converter data addition. M or 2 - converter data modification.

secondary_voltage.description: Line-to-line base voltage of the secondary side of the six-pulse bridge converter transformer, in kV.

transformer_power.description: Power base of the six-pulse bridge converter transformer, in MVA.

himvar_mode.description: DC link operating mode selector: N for normal operation, or H for HiMVAr Consumption mode.

name.description: Alphanumeric identification of the DC link name.

operation.description: A or 0 - DC link data addition. M or 2 - DC link data modification.

power_base.description: DC link power base, in MW.

state.description: L if the DC link is in operation. D if the DC link is out of operation.

voltage.description: Nominal DC link operating voltage, in kV.

element_type_1.description: First element type. BARR specifies a bus, AREA an area, TENS a voltage base, and AG01 through AG10 an aggregator.

element_id_1.description: Identifier of the first element: bus number, area number, voltage base, or aggregator identifier.

condition_1.description: First condition operator. A specifies an interval condition. E specifies a union condition.

element_type_2.description: Second element type. BARR specifies a bus, AREA an area, TENS a voltage base, and AG01 through AG10 an aggregator.

element_id_2.description: Identifier of the second element: bus number, area number, voltage base, or aggregator identifier.

main_condition.description: Main condition between the sets defined by conditions 1 and 2. X means difference, E union, and S intersection.

element_type_3.description: Third element type. BARR specifies a bus, AREA an area, TENS a voltage base, and AG01 through AG10 an aggregator.

element_id_3.description: Identifier of the third element: bus number, area number, voltage base, or aggregator identifier.

condition_2.description: Second condition operator. A specifies an interval condition. E specifies a union condition.

element_type_4.description: Fourth element type. BARR specifies a bus, AREA an area, TENS a voltage base, and AG01 through AG10 an aggregator.

element_id_4.description: Identifier of the fourth element: bus number, area number, voltage base, or aggregator identifier.

operation.description: A - addition of fixed CTAP-control data. E - elimination of fixed CTAP-control data.

interconnection.description: T fixes automatic tap voltage control for all selected transformers. I fixes only selected interconnection circuits.

DTPF.function: Reading of fixed data for automatic tap voltage-control application (CTAP) by selected element sets.

from_bus_1.description: From bus of the first selected circuit.

to_bus_1.description: To bus of the first selected circuit.

circuit_1.description: Identification number of the first selected parallel AC circuit.

from_bus_2.description: From bus of the second selected circuit.

to_bus_2.description: To bus of the second selected circuit.

circuit_2.description: Identification number of the second selected parallel AC circuit.

from_bus_3.description: From bus of the third selected circuit.

to_bus_3.description: To bus of the third selected circuit.

circuit_3.description: Identification number of the third selected parallel AC circuit.

from_bus_4.description: From bus of the fourth selected circuit.

to_bus_4.description: To bus of the fourth selected circuit.

circuit_4.description: Identification number of the fourth selected parallel AC circuit.

from_bus_5.description: From bus of the fifth selected circuit.

to_bus_5.description: To bus of the fifth selected circuit.

circuit_5.description: Identification number of the fifth selected parallel AC circuit.

operation.description: A - addition of fixed CTAP-control data. E - elimination of fixed CTAP-control data.

DTPF_CIRC.function: Reading of fixed data for automatic tap voltage-control application (CTAP) by explicitly selected circuits when DTPF CIRC is active.

group.description: Voltage base group identifier, as defined in the Voltage Base Group field of the DBAR execution code.

voltage.description: Base voltage associated with the group, in kV.

DGBT.function: Reading of AC bus voltage base group data.

emergency_maximum_voltage_limit.description: Maximum voltage limit, in p.u., associated with the voltage limit group under emergency conditions.

emergency_minimum_voltage_limit.description: Minimum voltage limit, in p.u., associated with the voltage limit group under emergency conditions.

group.description: Voltage limit group identifier, as defined in the Voltage Limit Group field of the DBAR execution code.

maximum_voltage_limit.description: Maximum voltage limit, in p.u., associated with the voltage limit group.

minimum_voltage_limit.description: Minimum voltage limit, in p.u., associated with the voltage limit group.

DGLT.function: Reading of voltage limit group data.
